description: Use for 'who should I reach about this lead, and why?'. Pass a lead id (eop_... or a match of your own rule) from list_opportunities or get_daily_brief. Returns the person who most likely owns it and why: name, role, LinkedIn, and a verified work email when there is one (never for EU, EEA or UK companies), or a LinkedIn search for the right title when nobody is named. Who and why only: Intakra never writes or sends messages.

opportunity_id.description: The lead id from list_opportunities or get_daily_brief (starts with eop_, or rh_ for a match of your own rule)

name: get_best_contact

email.description: Never for EU, EEA or UK companies.

contact.description: The person named for the lead, or null when nobody is named yet.

email.description: Never for EU, EEA or UK companies.

linkedin_search.description: A LinkedIn people search for the likely title, when nobody is named.
